note.text: task-mastermind-subcard-columns-2 changed ux/Card/, ux/Inbox/'s --inbox-subw default and ai2/card.js (2026-10-03, public/framework/ai/2026-10-03/subcard-columns/): the per-card chat column is gone, replaced by a quiet read-only properties sidebar (type/status/cost/tags/who worked on it/files/Actions); detail+sub columns are equal width; header shows status only while something is running; a card's content() is no longer shadowed when its page.jsonl uses page_add()'s content list (routed to card.dashboard instead). If your work touches the card template, sidebar or the chat column, read ux/Card/readme.md first.
